changes.problem: 两字节COT被当作单一uint16，响应继承请求cause说明且originator没有独立现场关联。
changes.resolution: 显式拆分cause/PN/test低字节与originator高字节；逐消息修正cause说明，三种响应都copy核对实际请求originator。

changes.problem: negative只有copy依赖，可改变状态但无法以关联依赖完成pending；response-side sequence_number误示收到响应时会更新自己的序号。
changes.resolution: positive/negative的CA改为correlate_request_response，保留QOI/originator比较；termination保留copy作后续响应；移除响应上的sequence_number声明。
增加starting/stopping的TESTFR请求/确认自环和interrogating/interrogation_data的s_ack自环；执行器允许S确认和TESTFR控制绕过应用pending，控制pending单独跟踪。

changes.problem: N(S)/N(R)、窗口和计时规则曾仅以字段与guard文字描述，fixed字段与现场重绑定字段也进入无效变异采样。
changes.resolution: 加入 connection-scoped IEC104 session：独立15位序号、累计确认、k/w、边界计时检查和独立START/STOP/TEST pending；请求序号由会话实际绑定，单值VSQ/IOA固定并排除无效采样。

codec_constraints.constraint: Every APDU starts68 with length=APDU bytes-2; native codec bounds6..255 bytes and validates I/S/U control structure. All example bytes have explicit abs fields.
U frames contain exactly6 bytes; STARTDT act/con controls07/0B, STOPDT13/23, TESTFR43/83 and other control octets zero.

S frame contains6 bytes, first control word0001(little endian), and a wire receive sequence with bit0 clear. The executor binds outgoing N(R) to the next observed peer I-frame number; incoming S acknowledgements update the independent send window without consuming application pending.
I frames contain16 bytes: one C_IC_NA_1(Type100) object, VSQ=1/SQ=0, two COT octets, CA UInt16, IOA UInt24 fixed0 and QOI20..36. Send/receive wire sequence bit0 must be clear.

COT abs8 is cause/PN/test: request06, positive07, negative47 and termination0A in low7 bits, with test bit independently accepted by codec kind matching. abs9 is the separate originator octet; values is not an acceptance whitelist.

Compare actual response CA, QOI and originator against cached interrogation request; CA uses correlate_request_response and requires/clears that pending request. No response value is fabricated from fixture defaults.
Termination follows positive confirmation in interrogation_data and compares CA/QOI/originator using cached request copy checks; it does not require a second pending completion.

The executor binds outgoing wire N(S)/N(R) from independent 15-bit connection counters, checks exact incoming N(S), and validates cumulative N(R) inside the outstanding send window, including wraparound. The same session is part of prepare/commit/cancel snapshots; received peer sequence fields are not local dependency writers.

The bounded client session enforces k<=128, w<=k, t0 before initial STARTDT, t1 for pending controls and oldest unacknowledged I-frame, w/t2 receive-acknowledgement requirements and t3 idle TESTFR requirements when processing send/receive calls. START/STOP/TEST pending are independent from the single application pending; S and TESTFR sends are allowed during interrogation pending. Session begin resets connection counters and timers. This module performs no autonomous scheduling or transport I/O.

remaining_gaps.description: Only single-object C_IC_NA_1 and bounded APCI client-initiated controls are represented. Monitoring/command ASDUs, multiple objects, security/TLS and the complete IEC104 standard are absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add separately sourced ASDU type/quality/time layouts and state/session behavior together with codec/grammar support before claiming full standard coverage.

remaining_gaps.description: Timer and window rules are checked when the host processes send/receive calls. No autonomous scheduler emits S/TESTFR frames, polls deadlines or reconnects an idle connection; k is a bounded local maximum128. Application requests still use one pending transaction.
remaining_gaps.resolution: For continuous sessions, add host scheduling and explicit reconnect policy with deterministic timer tests and controlled transport tests. Retain the existing serial single-interrogation contract until then.

remaining_gaps.description: Real interrogation can return monitoring data ASDUs between confirmation and termination. The codec only accepts the declared C_IC_NA_1 forms and rejects server-initiated U-control conversations; incoming S acknowledgements are now handled independently.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Extend message grammar and asynchronous response handling; do not treat omitted data or an accepted confirmation as full interrogation-session validation.

remaining_gaps.description: Published generic_wire.json is still offline-only with four fixed message grammars; it has no complete sequence, phase, negative/termination or originator-binding implementation matching this reviewed source.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Extend generic session/sequence and multi-response capabilities, then build and independently check a full generic description; do not enable online merely by changing its boolean.

remaining_gaps.description: This directory remains source-only. Native preparation and sanitizer session/runtime checks were executed separately during the executor extension; controlled local run results and mutation-sampling limits are recorded in the extension report. They do not demonstrate full industrial device sessions or method effectiveness.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Consult docs/executor-extension-20261104.zh-CN.md for exact current run outcomes and output paths. Add independent data-ASDU/control interoperability and fixed-budget comparison evidence before broader claims.
